chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"The one who consumes usury, the one who gives it, its scribe, and its two witnesses are equal in sin."

key_terms.آكِلُ: the one who consumes or takes
key_terms.الرِّبَا: usury or interest-based gain that is forbidden
key_terms.كَاتِبُهُ: the one who records or writes the transaction
key_terms.مُؤْكِلُهُ: the one who gives or pays it to another

ai.seo_question: Who shares the sin of riba in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith states that all direct participants in a usurious transaction share in its sin, not only the one who takes usury. It emphasizes the grave prohibition of riba and extends moral and legal responsibility to those who facilitate and document it.
